# StatusLight { #anylumino.StatusLight }

```python
StatusLight(value=True, description='', variant='', disabled=False, **kwargs)
```

Spectrum status-light display control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                        | Default   |
|-------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value       | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                                                             | `True`    |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                                                                                     | `''`      |
| variant     | optional | Spectrum visual variant such as ``'accent'``, ``'primary'``, ``'negative'``, ``'positive'``, or ``'informative'``. | `''`      |
| disabled    | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                                                              | `False`   |
